Yang et al. 2021.description: Scaling relationships for Australian intraplate reverse-faulting earthquakes from Yang et al. (2021), GSA Bulletin. Fitted to 11 historical (1968-2018) Mw 4.7-6.6 Australian reverse-faulting surface ruptures, combined with the Ungava event. Note MD here is maximum surface displacement; the paper reports MD is approximated by 3.3 +/- 1.6 (1 sigma) x AD.
Yang et al. 2021.citation: Yang, H., Quigley, M., and King, T. (2021). Surface slip distributions and geometric complexity of intraplate reverse-faulting earthquakes. GSA Bulletin, 133(9/10), 1909-1929. doi:10.1130/B35809.1

MD_from_Mw.description: Maximum Displacement from Moment Magnitude (Australia+Ungava Fit)

SRL_from_Mw.description: Surface Rupture Length from Moment Magnitude (Australia+Ungava Fit)
